# Step - properties

`properties` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Yields the property elements of vertices/edges (all, or the given keys).

## Forms

```text
properties()
properties(arg1: any)
properties(arg1: array)
properties(arg1: any, arg2: any)
properties(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).properties("age").value().next()   // 29
```

## See also

- [Property Elements](../../users_guide/property_elements.md)
